editorialRule: Use the Wrath-era Icecrown palette of dark blue-black Scourge stone and glacier ice; distinguish the Dragonblight cavern from citadel architecture and the green Plagueworks, ruby Crimson Hall, blue Frostwing Halls, and exposed Frozen Throne. Show Tirion holding the complete Ashbringer in the final scene. Display a Death Knight as one noncanonical eligible class variant; do not imply that one player avatar represents all class variants. The five relic returns are separate scenes and only their named object appears in each return scene.
assetProvenance: Original raster environment, character, creature and prop illustrations generated with built-in OpenAI ImageGen and converted to optimized WebP using FFmpeg. Generated art is interpretive, not canonical game art or proof of a lore claim.
